Cost of Dental Implants vs. Treatment Abroad

Written By

Dental Implants Team

The allure of 'Dental Tourism' has skyrocketed in recent years. Slick Instagram ads for Turkey dental implants promise a Hollywood smile for a fraction of UK prices. But is it really a bargain?

At Dental Implants London, we are increasingly treating patients who have returned from abroad with complications. These range from loose implants and chronic infections to aesthetic disasters that are difficult and expensive to fix. Before you book that flight to Istanbul or Budapest, it is crucial to understand the true cost of 'cheap' dentistry.

The 'Turkey Teeth' Phenomenon: Aggressive Dentistry

One of the biggest risks with overseas clinics is the aggressive preparation of teeth. To fit treatments into a one-week holiday, some clinics aggressively file down healthy teeth to stumps for crowns ('veneers'), rather than taking the time for orthodontics or minimally invasive bonding.

Once tooth structure is removed, it never grows back. This can lead to nerve death, root canals, and eventual tooth loss years later.

Implant Traceability

There are hundreds of implant brands available worldwide. Reputable clinics use well-established brands with parts available globally. However, many budget clinics use cheaper, local 'clone' implants to cut costs.

If you have a problem 5 years later in the UK, local dentists may not have the tools or parts to service an obscure implant brand. This often means the entire implant must be trephined (drilled) out and replaced, a traumatic and costly procedure.

The Hidden Costs of Complications

If an infection develops after you return home, you cannot simply pop back to Istanbul. UK dentists may not be able to fix failed work from abroad, and emergency dental clinics typically only offer extraction.

Corrective work in the UK can cost 3x more than the original treatment. The initial saving is quickly wiped out by flights, hotels, and revision surgery.

Our Competitive London Pricing

We believe high-quality implant dentistry should be accessible. By optimizing our workflows and focusing purely on implants, we have driven our costs down without compromising safety.

Our implants start from £2,950 (including the Zirconia crown). When you factor in flights, accommodation, insurance, and the risk of return trips, the 'saving' abroad is often negligible.

Plus, you get full UK consumer protection, GDC-registered care, and aftercare right on your doorstep in South Kensington.
